{{/* The browse-all table on /recipes/all/: one row per recipe with model (logo, name, HF org), size, architecture, precision, the clouds and GPUs it was verified on, and the description as notes. Only pages with `model` front matter are recipes; that filter keeps this page itself out of the list. */}} {{ $all := where (site.GetPage "/recipes").RegularPages.ByWeight "Params.model" "!=" nil }} {{/* Sort by vendor (data-file order) so a vendor's models sit together, keeping the curated weight order within each vendor. */}} {{ $recipes := slice }} {{ range hugo.Data.recipes.vendors }} {{ $vendor := .name }} {{ range $all }} {{ if eq (index (.Params.vendors | default slice) 0) $vendor }}{{ $recipes = $recipes | append . }}{{ end }} {{ end }} {{ end }} {{/* Recipes without a matching vendor entry still get listed, at the end. */}} {{ range $all }} {{ if not (in $recipes .) }}{{ $recipes = $recipes | append . }}{{ end }} {{ end }}
{{ range $recipes }} {{ $vendorName := index (.Params.vendors | default slice) 0 | default "" }} {{ $entry := dict "name" (or $vendorName .Title) }} {{ range hugo.Data.recipes.vendors }}{{ if eq .name $vendorName }}{{ $entry = . }}{{ end }}{{ end }} {{ end }}
